purposes.description: Non-default `purpose` values this Business supports, keyed by value (e.g., `recommendation`, `swap`). `search` is always supported, whether explicit or implied by omission, and need not be listed. When absent or empty, only `search` is supported. A Platform MUST NOT send a non-default `purpose` value absent from this map.

purpose_policy.title: Purpose Policy
purpose_policy.description: Policy for one supported `purpose` value. An empty object means the value is supported with no additional policy. Open for non-breaking extension.

supports_contextual.description: Whether the Business returns recommendations when `reference_ids` is omitted, from `context` and `signals` alone. When `false` or absent, a `recommendation` request MUST carry at least one `reference_ids` entry, and a Platform MUST NOT send one without it.

purpose.description: Retrieval purpose of the request. Well-known values: `search` (default when omitted), `recommendation`, `swap`. A Platform MUST NOT send a non-default value the Business does not advertise in its capability `config.purposes`; `search` is always supported, whether explicit or implied by omission. A Business MUST reject a value it does not support (error code `unsupported_purpose`) rather than falling back to a general browse.

reference_ids.description: Anchor product or variant identifiers for relational discovery. Applies to non-default `purpose` values and is ignored when `purpose` is `search` or omitted. Resolution follows Catalog Lookup's supported identifiers. Referenced products and variants are excluded from the returned products.

Anchors for complementary or related items. Multiple identifiers form one joint anchor set, and results need not relate to every anchor. When a variant ID is supplied, its parent product MUST also be excluded. Required unless the Business advertises `supports_contextual: true` for `recommendation`, in which case omitting it requests recommendations from `context` and `signals` alone.

Required single anchor identifying the item being replaced. It MUST resolve to one product or variant; a product ID is one anchor even when the product has several variants. If it resolves to more than one, the Business MUST NOT choose one and MUST return an `ambiguous_reference` error. Supply a variant ID when known so the Business can consider options, price, and `quantity_unit`; these guide relevance but are not matching constraints. When a variant ID is supplied, its parent product SHOULD be excluded unless a distinct substitute variant of that product is returned.

actions.description: Outstanding extension-defined Actions for this catalog search response.

messages.description: Errors, warnings, or informational messages about the search results.

policies.description: Policies (e.g., return/refund terms) that apply to the products in these search results. `applies_to` targets are relative to the response root; when absent or empty, refer to the URLs in `links[]`.

platform_schema.title: Catalog Search Capability (Platform)
platform_schema.description: Platform-level catalog search capability declaration. No platform config is required.

business_schema.title: Catalog Search Capability (Business)
business_schema.description: Business declaration for catalog search. Businesses advertise the non-default `purpose` values they support in `config.purposes`.
